# `collation`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the collation name of a given expression.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
collation(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- collation, example 1
> SELECT collation('Spark SQL');
SYSTEM.BUILTIN.UTF8_BINARY
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
